source_title: Amateur Astronomer? Be a Kilonova Catcher!
source_excerpt: Neutron stars are the ultra-dense, city-sized leftovers of dead stars. When they collide, they can release a brief flash of light called a kilonova. These immensely powerful events forge much of the universe’s gold, platinum and other heavy elements.
